title: Oliver Otter's Puddle Song
description: Oliver Otter worries his singing voice sounds too squeaky until he learns how happy it makes the river frogs.
character_reference: a playful young river otter with sleek brown fur, a light cream belly, and webbed paws splashing in shallow water

scenes.narration: Oliver floated lazily on his back in the calm river current, humming a quiet tune into the twilight air.
scenes.visual: close-up of a sleek furry snout pointed upward with closed eyes while floating on gentle ripples

scenes.narration: He stopped suddenly, worrying his voice was much too high and squeaky compared to the deep bullfrogs.
scenes.visual: expression of doubt with whiskers twitching while looking down at the moving water reflection

scenes.narration: A tiny green frog hopped onto a floating lily pad and blinked its big golden eyes at him.
scenes.visual: macro shot of a wet green frog sitting closely on a broad circular leaf pad

scenes.narration: Instead of swimming away, the frog let out a gentle ribbit that harmonized perfectly with his melody.
scenes.visual: side angle showing the otter smiling broadly while the green frog tilts its head in rhythm

scenes.narration: Encouraged, Oliver sang a little louder, turning his ripples into a joyful splashing song.
scenes.visual: dynamic action shot of webbed paws gently patting the water surface sending glittering drops into the air

scenes.narration: More frogs joined in the chorus until the entire riverbank echoed with a sweet bedtime lullaby.
scenes.visual: wide serene river view reflecting pale stars and glowing fireflies along the grassy banks

scenes.narration: Our unique voice is always welcome in the great chorus of life.
scenes.visual: peaceful twilight scene of the otter resting his chin on a smooth mossy rock

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: warm glowing close-up of a friendly woodland creature waving happily toward the camera
